content: Jekope Isopa Kando Nyiyambi
Jekope kandeyamo dokopa Iso baa akali andete kisima (400) pipya role pyao epeyami. Doko kandapala wane dupwa Liya Oresolo dee kendemande enda dolapope keta lili pyuo maiya.
Maipala enda kendemande dolapo wane pipyawambo karena lao dee Liya wane pipya dokona pako kanya karena lao Oresolo Josepe baapa nyuo lumwa pyuo karo piya.
Dopa pipala baa pao wambapala yangongena lenge kambu siya dokona yuu yanda ipingi nyepo pangu sepa piya.
Dopa piyamopape Iso waiya lao epapala baa kupyuo nyinyi pyuo nyiyasa dokopa nakamba ee leyambi.

Dopa pyuo Isome enda wanepe dupwa kandalyuo kandapala lao, Emba role pyao epelyaminyi dupwa apimoose? leya. Dokopa Jekopemeisingi lao, Anatumi namba embena kendemande akali doko wane wanake dupwa ipyapala jiyamo dupwaŋa, leya.
Dokopa kendemande enda dolapo wane pipya repeta epo pangu siyami.
Dokopa Liya baa banya wane wanakepe pipya repeta epo pangu siyami. Dee enakana lumwa pyuo dokona Josepe Oresolopa repeta epapala pangu soo yako leyambi.
Dokopa Isome lao, Wambu wambo iminyi kando nyipu dupwa apa lao suu pyao peyapisi? leya. Leyamo dokopa Jekopeme isingi lao, Emba nambana kamongo dokome namba rae maiyuo kando nyere laopipu, leya.
Dopa leyamopape Isome lao, Nambana bange kapa silyamoŋo embena dupwa mee range sinyale, leya.

Dokopa Jekopeme poraiyuo kongo pyuo lao, Daaŋa. Emba nambapa rae mairi ramo doko bange jilyu dupwa nyere. Emba anjiki pyuo namba yako lao nyipisa embena lenge kambu doko Anatunya lenge kambu kandenge dopale ingyapyamo kando nyilyu, leya.
Anatumi namba nyisiyasa bange malu dupwa namba keta silyamo dokona lao lasaka pilyu dupwa mee nyelase lao karo nyepeyamo dokopa kaeya.
Dokopa Isome lao, Kapaŋa. Nambame laminyaroleŋe kata nyuo role pyao monale, leyamopape

Jekope isingi lamaiyuo, Wane nyaŋa dupwa poraiya nalyamo dee mena inya dupwa yakane manjiminyi kandalene. Yuu gii mendaki iki dokona mena dupwa ipyuo minyuo makandarama ramo dokopa kumuo otarami ingilyamo, leya.
Emba wambo parenepa dokona namba enakana moko minyuo eparo. Mena wanepe dupwa eparaminyili pyuo lanyuo epo yuu Siya dokona emba kando nyeroŋo, leya.

Dokona Isome lao, Dopa pyuo piri ramo doko nambana akali lapo embamoo pipya yaki nyepala parowale, leya. Leyamopa Jekopeme isingi lamaiyuo, Embame nambapa yulu keyange pyuo leene doŋo akali dupwame pirami mende see nalyamo, leya.
Leyasa Iso yuu gii dokopa kapu kyepala yuu Siya dokona range peya.
Dopa piyamopape enakana Jekope sipurapala yuu Sakote dokona peya. Papala Jekope baa rangena anda pyuo dee mena dupwana anda pyakamyuo piya. Dokona lao yuu doko Sakote leyami.

Dokona dee sipurapala epo yuu Kenane dokona taone mende Sikeme lenge doko kando nyiya. Baa wamba yuu Mesopotemia dokonako piso epeya kande. Yuu mende yuu taone dorena ingyuo siyamo dokona komau anda pyuo paleyami.
Doo paleyamo yuu dolapo Emona wambu dupwana akali mende Sikemena rakange dokona yuunde doko Jekopeme ropo pyao kana kulingi andete mendaki (100) maiya.
Yuu dokona baame mena pyao kiso maingi kana pyare leya. Lapala kingi Ele Isaraelena Anatu doko leya.
